caseName: American Water Works & Guaranty Co. v. City of Little Rock

opinions.text: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Arkansas. April 8, 1904. Dismissed with costs, on authority of counsel for the appellant. Mr. J. M. Moore for appellant. Mr. W. L. Terry and Mr. Morris M. Cohn for appellees.
